verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is itself a coding agent, which would normally make this server-role story not applicable. However, the vendor's GitHub org publishes an official MCP server (ByteAsk-Embedded-MCP) that serves page-cited embedded and firmware reference-doc answers to other coding agents, so the axis applies. That server exposes a narrow docs-lookup capability rather than ByteAsk's own agent functions (editing, toolchain runs, gdb), and the evidence is only a repo tagline plus a probe pointer. Missing for 10: setup and connection documentation, a tool list and transport details, exposure of ByteAsk's core agent capabilities over MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
